class: A database pool that hands out a pooled connection without testing it turns any connection the network or the server dropped into a failed request (a 500) for the next user, until the pool happens to replace it.
mechanism: backend/ofo_app/db.py get_engine: create_async_engine without pool_pre_ping or pool_recycle (since 66fcea59, 2026-10-19).

first_seen.where: GC-MU screen proofs, dev API on ofo_dev through the tunnel
first_seen.evidence: 12 Compare calls 30 s apart: 2 answered 500 (ERR-050A78CF, ERR-90B771BD), asyncpg InterfaceError 'connection is closed'

fix: Not fixed (#631): pool_pre_ping=True (or a pool_recycle shorter than the drop interval) plus a test that kills the pooled connection and asserts the next request succeeds.
